notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP GET (curl with a standard Chrome desktop User-Agent) succeeded for every page fetched - homepage, https://www.kare.de/sitemap.xml, https://www.kare.de/sitemap_categories.xml, and every candidate category page. Site is Nuxt SSR: full rendered HTML (h1, breadcrumb, product-count text) is present in the raw HTTP response, no client-side JS execution or Playwright/CDP escalation was needed, and no block/CAPTCHA/DataDome was encountered at any point. robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' with only legacy scraper/SEO bots disallowed; no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry present, so tier (a) is unrestricted (tier c was never needed). TREE: built from the union of sitemap_categories.xml (146 category URLs) plus the mega-menu markup embedded in each fetched page (KARE's SSR only expands the currently-active top-nav section's children in the HTML, so multiple category pages were fetched specifically to reveal each section's true child list) plus breadcrumb confirmation (Startseite > ACCESSOIRES > <parent> > <child>) on every leaf recorded, per STEP2 rule 2. Found /c/decken-plaids (Blankets & Throws) via nav even though it is absent from sitemap_categories.xml; verified 200 OK, correct h1 'Decken & Plaids', and breadcrumb placing it under Teppiche & Textilien - exactly the 'bad/missing-from-sitemap slug that is still real' case the brief warns about. QTY: exact 'N Produkte' text taken from each leaf's own page (rendered twice - once for the mobile layout, once for desktop - both identical, confirmed not an aggregation). h1 matched the requested slug on every leaf. EXCLUDED - Schraenke, Regale, Kommoden-Sideboards (cabinets/shelves/sideboards/wardrobes): breadcrumb confirms MOEBEL (Furniture) parent; KARE's own hierarchy places these as Furniture, not Storage (storage.md SS21/27). Dekoration and children (Aschenbecher, Buchstuetzen, Dekoschalen, Figuren-Skulpturen, Kerzen-Leuchter, Kunstpflanzen, Spardosen, Uhren-Wecker, Vasen, Wind-Teelichter) = Decorative Home Accessories, excluded from both. Geschirr & Tischaccessoires and children (Besteck, Geschirrsets, Glas-Glasware, Schalen-Schuesseln, Tabletts, Tassen-Becher, Teller-Platten, Tischaccessoires) = Kitchen & Dining, excluded from both; the site has no tablecloth/napkin/table-linen category. Accessoires-Sonstige (6 products: paper-roll holder, velvet-rope stanchions/cordons) = neither Textile nor Storage. Gartenaccessoires (22 mixed products: garden gnomes, decor bowls/vases, a hanging chair, but also 1 'Kissen 70x70cm Outdoor' cushion and several 'Outdoor Teppich Adorno' rug variants) was NOT recorded: there is no dedicated Textile-only subcategory URL for the outdoor cushion/rug items on this site - they sit inside one mixed general garden-decor listing whose primary type is Decorative Home Accessories, and pulling out only the textile subset would require estimating/aggregating a sub-count, which is prohibited (textile.md SS28, storage rule against estimation). Wanddekoration (48 products, all metal wall mirrors/objects, no tapestries or fabric wall hangings) = Wall Decor, excluded. Room-aggregator landing pages (Wohnzimmer, Schlafzimmer, Esszimmer, Buero-Arbeitszimmer, Flur-Diele, Kueche-Haushalt, Balkon-Garten) are cross-category 'shop by room' filters that re-list the same underlying product-type categories under a room tag rather than being distinct category-tree leaves; not recorded, consistent with 'room name alone must never determine classification' (textile.md S2) and to avoid duplicate/aggregated rows. Garderoben / Garderobenstaender / Wandgarderoben-Leisten / Schirmstaender (coat stands, wall coat racks, umbrella stands) = furniture/hardware fixtures, not storage containers or organizers, excluded from Storage.
